en.age.allowHow: You can exempt TheOne only: dsh-theone is added to the exceptions in this DSH profile's pnpm settings (pnpm-workspace.yaml) and installed now. Other plugins keep the 24-hour rule.
en.age.cannot: This DSH profile's pnpm settings cannot be changed from here. Wait 24 hours, or reinstall from the GitHub address.
en.age.readyAt: Without the exemption, you can update after {time}.
en.age.title: This version is less than 24 hours old
en.age.why: DSH installs plugins with pnpm, which by default only installs versions published at least 24 hours ago, as a guard against tampered packages. TheOne {version} was published recently, so it cannot be installed yet.

en.bg.hintFollow: Background model: {model} (following DSH's default). Click to pin another model.

en.feedback.description: What happened? For example: garbled text in a reply, the wrong topic, a button that does nothing
en.feedback.error.DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Say in a sentence what happened first.
en.feedback.error.DIRECT_OFF: Sending directly is turned off in this DSH.
en.feedback.error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many reports in a short time; try again in an hour.
en.feedback.error.REJECTED: The feedback server did not accept this report.
en.feedback.error.SERVER_ERROR: The feedback server has a problem right now.
en.feedback.error.TOO_LARGE: Too long; shorten the description or leave out the reply text.
en.feedback.error.UNREACHABLE: The feedback server cannot be reached.
en.feedback.fallback: You can also press Copy and email {email}.
en.feedback.includeReply: Include this message and its reply as text (needed for problems like garbled replies)
en.feedback.intro: Tell us what happened. Everything that would be sent is shown below; nothing leaves this computer until you press Send.
en.feedback.loadError: Diagnostics could not be gathered. You can still describe the problem, copy it and email {email}.
en.feedback.privacy: Sent to feedback.yulid.org, used only to look into the problem, and deleted by TheOne's author after 90 days. By default it holds versions, settings and routing error codes and timings, no chat content.
en.feedback.sent: Sent as {id}. Mention this id in a comment or email and the author can find it. Thank you!
en.feedback.title: Report a problem
en.feedback.titleMessage: Report a problem with this reply

en.link.off: Topic linking is off. Turn it on in TheOne settings.
en.link.privateHint: This topic is never given to other topics as reference
en.manage.attachHint: The whole session becomes history this topic can search; the session itself is unchanged.
en.manage.busy: A reply is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
en.manage.constraintsLabel: Constraints (related topics must follow them when using this information)
en.manage.constraintsPlaceholder: For example: budget figures are for purchasing only, keep them out of the paper
en.manage.deleteHint: Removes only TheOne's catalog entry. DSH keeps the original sessions, and the catalog will not extract this topic again.
en.manage.error: The change could not be made. Check the input and try again.
en.manage.mergeHint: This topic's history, progress, constraints and links move into the target topic, and this topic leaves the directory. You can undo the merge from the target topic; DSH keeps the original sessions.
en.manage.title: Title
en.notice.label: Notice
en.route.reason.handback: Handed back by the first topic
en.routes.hint: Move a misrouted message to the right topic here: TheOne remembers, routes similar messages there from now on, and continues the next message in that topic. You can also say "wrong topic, it is the X one" in main chat, and the previous message is redone in the right topic.
en.routes.stats: Last {total}: {rate}% kept as routed, {clarified} asked back
en.routes.title: Recent topic routing
en.settings.compression: Retention policy: current and recently frequent topics keep more detail; topics unused for 30 days keep short summaries. Original chats remain in DSH. These rules are not individually configurable yet.
en.settings.conflict: Another page changed these settings. Reload before saving.
en.settings.contextsUnreadable: Cannot read this topic catalog file. Check the path and JSON format.
en.settings.error: Configuration could not load. Check your DSH connection.
en.settings.help.catalogIntervalMs: Time between checks for history changes; minimum 10 seconds.
en.settings.help.contextsPath: Optional JSON file with a hand-written topic catalog. It is read and imported when saved; clearing it does not remove topics already imported.
en.settings.help.databasePath: Stores the catalog, groups, links and routing records; DSH keeps the original chats. Changing it switches TheOne to a different set of data, so it is not editable here: set THEONE_DATABASE_PATH and restart DSH.
en.settings.help.factExtraction: With shared facts on, one small model call after each turn records facts the topic session left out; again only facts the user confirmed are shared. Off by default; takes effect after DSH restarts.
en.settings.help.factLinks: Topics share only facts the user confirmed (figures, decisions, file locations), with version and source; when one changes or is withdrawn, topics that used it are told. Off by default; takes effect after DSH restarts.
en.settings.help.gatewayKey: Separates main-chat entry state (current topic, routing records, settings). Changing it amounts to a new entry, so it can only be set through THEONE_GATEWAY_KEY; usually leave it as default.
en.settings.help.historyCatalog: Extract and group topics from existing sessions. Turning this off keeps the current catalog.
en.settings.help.linkScope: Where related topics share progress: off, within a topic workspace only, or learned from use. Manual links and "Do not share" always take precedence.
en.settings.help.maxDescriptorChars: Maximum characters in the topic descriptor mounted in a worker; minimum 128.
en.settings.help.maxResponseChars: Maximum characters, thinking included, in one background step; minimum 128. Multi-step tasks are not limited by their total length.
en.settings.help.notices: Show notices from TheOne's author (new versions, important reminders). TheOne only reads one notice file from yulid.org and sends none of your data.
en.settings.help.routeNotice: How main chat shows topic changes: hidden, one line when the topic changes, or on every message.
en.settings.help.routerMode: llm uses the model to choose topics; rules uses rule-based decisions.
en.settings.help.workerModel: Pin the model used for routing, workers and entry capacity.
en.settings.help.workerProvider: Pick a provider to pin the background model; leave empty to follow main chat and DSH. Lists every model configured in DSH.
en.settings.imessageHandle: The phone number or Apple ID you text from:
en.settings.imessageHandleInvalid: Enter a phone number or an Apple ID email.
en.settings.imessageIntro: On a Mac: iMessage this Mac from your own phone number or Apple ID, and it works like talking in main chat; replies go back through Messages. Only the number you enter is listened to.
en.settings.imessageNoAccess: Messages' data cannot be read. Allow the app running DSH under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access, then try again.
en.settings.imessageNote: The first reply makes macOS ask whether DSH may control Messages; allow it. Nothing arrives while the Mac sleeps or DSH is closed.
en.settings.imessageUnsupported: iMessage works only on macOS: DSH has to run on a Mac signed in to Messages.
en.settings.inherited: DSH manages language, theme, API credentials and compaction thresholds. Entry capacity follows the model; the pointer glow is orange in light mode and pale blue in dark mode.
en.settings.modelUnavailable: Model information is unavailable. Check your DSH model settings.
en.settings.readOnly: Changes apply when saved; only History catalog and Rescan interval need a DSH restart. The database location and entry identifier can only be changed through environment variables; see their descriptions.
en.settings.remoteError: Could not read the connection status.
en.settings.remotePaused: The server refused the login for now; retrying in {minutes} min · account {account}
en.settings.restart: Saved. History catalog settings apply after DSH restarts; everything else already applies.
en.settings.saveError: Settings could not save. Check the inputs and DSH connection, then retry.
en.settings.subtitle: Review active configuration and what each option does.
en.settings.telegramExpired: The bot's token no longer works (it may have been reset in @BotFather). Enter it again.
en.settings.telegramIntro: Bind a Telegram bot of your own. Messages you send it work like talking in main chat, and the replies come back to Telegram. Only the person who completes pairing is listened to.
en.settings.telegramNote: The token stays on this computer. Messages arrive only while DSH is running.
en.settings.telegramPair: Scan this code to open {bot} and tap Start, or send {bot} the message /start {code} in Telegram. The first person to send the code becomes its owner.
en.settings.telegramToken: In Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot to make a bot, and paste the token it gives you here:
en.settings.telegramTokenInvalid: That token does not work. Copy it again from @BotFather.
en.settings.telegramUnreachable: Could not reach Telegram. Check the network (a proxy may be needed) and try again.
en.settings.title: TheOne settings
en.settings.updateCheckFailed: Could not check: the update source is unreachable. Check the network and try again.
en.settings.updateLatest: You have the latest version. TheOne also checks when DSH starts and every 6 hours after.
en.settings.weixinExpired: The login has expired. Scan again.
en.settings.weixinFailed: Binding did not work ({reason}). You can try again.
en.settings.weixinIntro: Scan to bind your own WeChat. Messages you send it there work like talking in main chat: they go to their topics and run in the background, and the reply comes back to WeChat. Only the person who scanned is listened to; nobody else reaches main chat.
en.settings.weixinNote: Uses Tencent's iLink interface (the same one as the OpenClaw WeChat plugin). Messages arrive only while DSH is running, not while the computer sleeps or DSH is closed.
en.settings.weixinScan: Scan this code with WeChat on your phone.
en.settings.weixinVerify: Your phone shows a verification code. Enter it here:
en.tasks.actionError: Could not complete this action. Check the PR URL and limits; the task state may have changed.
en.tasks.exhausted: Time or check limit reached. Create a new task to continue.
en.tasks.failure: Reading or analysis failed. Up to two retries are automatic; resume manually after that. The public API may be rate limited.
en.tasks.help: Check public GitHub PRs and CI summaries on this computer. New failures, passes and closure notify main chat. Checks resume when DSH reopens; no code is changed. Failure analysis uses the selected background model.
en.tasks.loadError: Tasks unavailable. Check your DSH connection.
en.tasks.openMain: Open TheOne main chat first, then retry.
en.tasks.passed: All retrieved checks pass, or PR closes
en.tasks.title: Ongoing tasks
en.topic.continueHidden: This topic’s conversations are gone from disk, so there is nothing to continue.
en.topic.hiddenArchived: Its conversations are archived: the topic is only put away, and picks up again when you mention it.
en.topic.hiddenOrphaned: Its conversations are gone from disk: this topic no longer takes part in routing. Delete it to remove it from the directory.
en.update.ageStill: TheOne is exempted, but pnpm still refused: {detail}. The full log is in .plugin-manager/logs in the DSH profile folder.
en.update.busy: A reply is in progress. Update once it finishes.
en.update.failedHint: The update did not finish ({error}). Click to retry, or reinstall from the Plugins page.
en.update.hint: You have {current}; {latest} is available. Click to update without restarting DSH.
en.update.manualHint: You have {current}; {latest} is available. This copy was not installed from GitHub or npm, so reinstall it from the Plugins page.
en.update.network: Could not reach the download source. Check the network and click to retry.
en.update.otherAge: pnpm refused: {names} is also less than 24 hours old, and only TheOne is exempted. Try again once it is a day old.
en.update.reloadingHint: TheOne is reloading with the new version; DSH keeps running, and the page refreshes when it is done.
en.update.restartHint: Updated. Restart DSH to apply it.
en.update.tooNew: DSH only installs versions published at least 24 hours ago, as a safety policy, and this one is newer. Try again later.
en.update.waitingHint: {latest} is out but less than 24 hours old. Click to see how to install it now.
